patterns.note: every EARS pattern = triggers x modals, plus trigger-less UBIQUITOUS; accept must cover the full cross product

accept.name: when-form
accept.statement: WHEN a work order is assigned, THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse implementation start

accept.name: if-form
accept.statement: IF mutants are fewer than configured, THE SYSTEM SHALL attribute contract-fault

accept.name: while-form
accept.statement: WHILE campaign is running, THE SYSTEM SHALL stream verdicts

accept.name: where-form
accept.statement: WHERE possible, THE SYSTEM SHALL evaluate with a different model

accept.name: ubiquitous-shall
accept.statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL exchange contract as A2A artifacts

accept.name: ubiquitous-must
accept.statement: THE SYSTEM MUST refuse unvalidated contracts

accept.name: conditional-must-trailing-period-stripped
accept.statement: WHEN expired, THE SYSTEM MUST reject.

accept.name: surrounding-whitespace-tolerated
accept.statement: WHEN whitespace padded ,   THE SYSTEM   SHALL trim response.

accept.name: multiline-trigger
accept.statement:
WHEN multi
line trigger, THE SYSTEM SHALL accept newlines

accept.name: if-must
accept.statement: IF the clause store is missing, THE SYSTEM MUST fail closed

accept.name: while-must
accept.statement: WHILE a mutant campaign runs, THE SYSTEM MUST sandbox bound suites

accept.name: where-must
accept.statement: WHERE a clause is judge-gated, THE SYSTEM MUST exclude it from deterministic coverage

reject.name: empty-statement
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: statement is empty
  statement: '   '
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: write a response, e.g. THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse unvalidated contracts

reject.name: lowercase-the-system
reject.statement: The system probably handles it fine.
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: keyword 'THE SYSTEM' is lowercase
  statement: 'The system probably handles it fine.'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: EARS keywords are uppercase: THE SYSTEM SHALL ...

reject.name: missing-system-clause
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: missing 'THE SYSTEM' clause
  statement: 'It shall log everything.'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: every EARS statement names the system: THE SYSTEM SHALL ...

reject.name: lowercase-modal
reject.statement: THE SYSTEM shall log every exchange
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: modal after 'THE SYSTEM' is 'shall', expected SHALL or MUST
  statement: 'THE SYSTEM shall log every exchange'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: the only valid modals are SHALL and MUST (uppercase)

reject.name: wrong-modal
reject.statement: THE SYSTEM probably refuses invalid contracts
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: modal after 'THE SYSTEM' is 'probably', expected SHALL or MUST
  statement: 'THE SYSTEM probably refuses invalid contracts'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: the only valid modals are SHALL and MUST (uppercase)

reject.name: missing-response-after-modal
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: response is missing after SHALL
  statement: 'THE SYSTEM SHALL'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]

reject.name: lowercase-trigger-keyword
reject.statement: when a contract arrives, THE SYSTEM SHALL validate it
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: trigger keyword is lowercase ('when')
  statement: 'when a contract arrives, THE SYSTEM SHALL validate it'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: EARS keywords are uppercase: WHEN/IF/WHILE/WHERE

reject.name: unknown-trigger-keyword
reject.statement: GIVEN a signed contract, THE SYSTEM SHALL accept it
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: statement starts with 'GIVEN', not a trigger keyword
  statement: 'GIVEN a signed contract, THE SYSTEM SHALL accept it'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: start with WHEN/IF/WHILE/WHERE for conditional statements, or go straight to 'THE SYSTEM' for a ubiquitous statement

reject.name: missing-comma-before-system
reject.statement: WHEN a contract arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL validate it
reject.expected_message:
not an EARS statement: trigger is not followed by a comma before 'THE SYSTEM'
  statement: 'WHEN a contract arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL validate it'
  expected: [<WHEN|IF|WHILE|WHERE> <trigger>,] THE SYSTEM <SHALL|MUST> <response> [.]
  hint: separate trigger and response with a comma: WHEN <trigger>, THE SYSTEM SHALL ...
